ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Medicaid Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: Investigate the extent of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota and the impact on the state's healthcare system
questions: What are the most common types of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota?
How much money is being lost to Medicaid fraud in the state?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to expose significant waste and abuse in the Medicaid system, and could lead to reforms and increased accountability.
